title: Add a reviewable public problem-report action
problem: A person who spots a wrong interpretation or failed visual has no obvious way to describe it and preserve the conversation needed to reproduce it. The producer now has configurable draft and submit endpoints and a conversational report-problem skill, but publication must remain an explicit, reviewable user action because the destination is public.
requested_outcome: Add a persistent 'Report a problem' action, with stronger visibility beside blocked, contradictory or error states.
Open a form with a required free-form description and an 'Include this conversation' checkbox switched on by default.
State clearly that the issue is public and identify the configured repository before drafting.
POST the visible user/assistant transcript to /v1/feedback/draft, then render the returned title and full body as an editable or reviewable preview.
Only POST report_id with confirmed=true to /v1/feedback/submit after a separate confirmation action.
If submit returns ready_for_browser_confirmation, open its pre-filled issue URL; if it returns submitted, show the returned issue URL.
Never include hidden prompts, progress events, raw tool output, credentials or private bridge context.
producer_evidence: dss/feedback/report_service.py creates immutable redacted drafts, limits transcript roles to user and assistant, and separates draft from submit.
ecology_memory/integration/codex_native/server.py exposes /v1/feedback/draft and /v1/feedback/submit and adds report_action metadata to visual summaries.
The report-problem bridge skill creates a draft only and reports that confirmation is still required.
dss/feedback/tests/test_report_service.py covers transcript filtering, default inclusion, exclusion and the confirmation boundary.
acceptance: The action is discoverable on an ordinary answer and visually prominent on a blocked or erroneous answer.
The form cannot draft without free-form text and defaults transcript inclusion to on.
The person sees the public warning, repository and complete issue preview before submission.
Cancelling or declining confirmation creates no public issue.
Turning transcript inclusion off removes the conversation from the draft.
A submitted or pre-filled issue contains visible chat only and links back through the audit id without exposing hidden execution context.
notes: The repository is producer configuration, not a consumer constant. The default is bprashanth/totalrecall, and a deployment may move it without a UI release.
